title: Dex App is losing connection to aaps 2.7.0 several times a day
body:
My Dex App is losing connection to aaps 2.7.0 several times a day. 

The only way to repair, is to toggle bluetooth off/on then aaps is recieving values again immediately.
Even the BT Watchdog doesn't seem to help here.
This happens several times for more than a hour. Clear cache and all these things doesn't help.

I'm using patched Dex G6 app with 81xx S/N Transmitters on a Samsung Galaxy S20 5G, Android 10

Here is a screen record of the issue. I'm using a different aaps repo with a new GUI but its at 2.7.0 master version. This issue occurs in the original 2.7.0 master too. Its not depeneding on the version I'm using.
https://streamable.com/3j3fdz

Error Log files for the depening time:
https://drive.google.com/folderview?id=1TQJcncHGTnTPoS6JMyD10ZxZIFa4_9Tq

![Screenshot_20201004-104525_AndroidAPS.png](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/45721291/95014788-834a5c80-0649-11eb-9607-b20b0a7c052b.png)

comments.body: I have the same problem.  Patched Dex App  Region3, mgdl, AAPS 2.7.0 original branch. Google Pixel 3, Android 11

I have the same problem, too. Patched Dex App "com.dexcom.g6.region3.mmol-patched.apk", AAPS dev branch from 2020-10-09, Samsung Galaxy S9, Android 10.

**With fix describe under https://github.com/MilosKozak/AndroidAPS/issues/2940#issuecomment-687730080, my problem was fixed at the moment. Hope the solution is permanently.**

The same problem was in my system yesterday. Started at 16:00 (+3h GMT) and continued almost all the time about 6 hours. BT off/on was the only way to have ago time to start from 0 min but after next 5 min it again counted into 10 min and skipped back into 5 min. My system is patched Dexcom app g6.region1.mmol (version 1.5.1.5). AAPS 2.7.0 main branch. "NS upload only (disabled sync)" = ON. NS not migrated yet. The problem has not occurred before yesterday even I have used 2.7.0 now about two weeks. There were also several other AAPS users yesterday in Fb discussion who had the same problem and the problem started yesterday afternoon.
Seems to be quite a problem for a lot of people! Missing values are really annoying and a quite important issue!

@MilosKozak 
since yesterday I turned off the NSClient in AAPS.  since then I have no more problems with missing blood glucose values.  is it possible that it is due to the NSClient?
if nsclient is crashing teoretically yes. but i don't know about it
